method_summary: Involutive Heegaard Floer theory with Nemethi graded roots, Dai-Manolescu monotone subroots, and connected Floer homology from Neumann plumbing lattices
problem_statement: Let Y_r = Sigma(2,9,r) for all integers r >= 5 with gcd(r,18) = 1 (the full coprime (2,9)-ray of Brieskorn-Seifert integer homology spheres with minimal negative-definite Neumann star-shaped plumbings). Compute the Nemethi graded roots and Dai-Manolescu monotone graded subroots M(Y_r) from the plumbing lattices via the Can-Karakurt Delta/tau lattice-point count, extract the connected Heegaard Floer homology HF_conn(Y_r), and test whether the subroots realize infinitely many distinct involutive local-equivalence classes with strictly growing HF_conn rank, so that the classes [Y_r] are linearly independent over Z in the integral homology cobordism group Theta^3_Z.
record_title: Involutive subroot separation along the coprime (2,9) Brieskorn ray: infinite linear independence in integral homology cobordism
